title: Dizz Tracked
html:
Dizz gets distracted by unneccessary side projects. Be it a compiler, a linker, a game, a browser etc.

Pro's & Con's

Pro:

  • never feels bored.

Con:

  • wastes a lot of time and work.

Going further than Dizz Tracked

Make a good roadmap.

Dizz Tracked's bookshelf

Book about compiler creation, game development, software rendering, "Crafting Interpreters" etc.

People and OSes related to Dizz Tracked

  • PeterX That's kind of me. But I'm trying to improve.
  • eekee - I actually need to be this, for now. I've got better at planning only to realise that I still need more practice with my chosen languages.
  • partisani: This page describes me perfectly.
  • Demindiro: "compiler" check, "game development" check, "software rendering" check, "interpreters" check ... oh dear. Well, I haven't made a browser or linker. Yet.
